name: TChess
tagline: Offline chess tactics trainer — 60,000 puzzles, zero ads
problem: Chess-improvement apps either need a constant connection or don't build real tactical pattern recognition through fast, repeated reps.
built: A mobile-first tactics trainer with a hand-built chess board and solving engine (no third-party chessboard library), 60,000 curated Lichess puzzles bundled into an offline SQLite database, an animated TikTok-style tactics feed that plays with zero network calls, gamified XP/streaks/achievements, and a Pro tier with opening tools and an AI coach.
result: 60,000 real puzzles verified against the engine with zero failures; 51,837 compiled cleanly into the offline feed. Free tier stays fully offline and ad-free.
description: Mobile-first tactics trainer with a hand-built board and engine, 60,000 puzzles bundled offline, and an animated tactics feed that plays with zero network calls.

name: ChessReel
tagline: Automated pipeline that turns chess puzzles into short-form video
problem: Growing a chess app from zero needs constant short-form content, but hand-editing chess videos doesn't scale past a handful a week.
built: A CPU-only Python pipeline that turns Lichess sacrifice puzzles into fully produced vertical videos — animated board, synthesized voiceover, sound effects, background music, and Claude-written captions — batch-producing dozens of ready-to-post reels per run.
result: Fully automated puzzle-to-video pipeline with no GPU or ML models required, feeding TChess's organic growth across Instagram, YouTube, and TikTok.
description: CPU-only Python pipeline that turns Lichess puzzles into fully produced vertical videos — board animation, voiceover, sound, music, and AI-written captions.

name: CertForge
tagline: Smart certification exam prep, starting with AWS Cloud Practitioner
problem: Cert prep apps dump question banks on users without telling them what they're actually weak on or when they're ready to sit the real exam.
built: A mobile app with intelligent weakness detection and adaptive question routing — real readiness scoring, full mock exams, and action-driven learning instead of a flat quiz bank.
result: Live on Google Play, published under Optivio Automation. AWS Cloud Practitioner is the first certification track, built to expand to additional certs on the same engine.
description: Mobile app with intelligent weakness detection and adaptive question routing. Real readiness scoring, full mock exams, action-driven learning.

name: DareClock
tagline: Alarm clock you can only stop by getting out of bed
problem: Snooze buttons make alarms optional. Waking up needs a task that forces you out of bed.
built: A native Android alarm that only stops when you finish a mission: push-ups counted live with on-device pose detection, a photo mission, or a mind puzzle.
result: Live on Google Play, published under Optivio Automation.
description: Native Android alarm that keeps ringing until you finish a push-up, photo or mind mission.

name: Brick Breaker: Power Rush
tagline: Arcade brick breaker with ball volleys and missions
problem: Casual brick breakers are mostly ad walls with little to master.
built: A Unity arcade game with ball volleys, ball upgrades and level missions, optional Google Play Games cloud save, and a remove-ads purchase.
result: Live on Google Play, published under Optivio Automation.
description: Unity arcade brick breaker with ball volleys, ball upgrades and level missions.

name: Instagram Outreach Automation
problem: Manually finding and messaging qualified leads on Instagram doesn't scale past a handful of accounts a day.
built: A custom pipeline: keyword → SerpAPI → Instagram URL extraction → Apify scraping → lead scoring → personalized DM generation → tracking dashboard, running unattended across 25 accounts.
result: 300 personalized DMs sent per day with zero manual lookup, tracked end-to-end on a custom dashboard.
description: Custom-built pipeline: keyword → SerpAPI → Instagram URL extraction → Apify scraping → lead scoring → personalized DM generation → tracking dashboard.

name: Optivio Chatbot
tagline: AI sales assistant for e-commerce stores
problem: Most e-commerce stores lose visitors who have a question at 2am and nobody to ask.
built: An embeddable AI chat widget that captures leads, answers product questions, and converts visitors into customers — billing, plans, and dashboard included.
result: Live SaaS product with plans from free to $99/mo, running on a production Next.js + Supabase stack.
description: Embeddable AI chat widget that captures leads, answers product questions, and converts visitors into customers. Plans from free to $99/mo.

name: Optivio Automation
tagline: AI receptionists for UK dental practices · Google Play publisher
problem: Dental practices lose new patients every time a call goes unanswered — after hours, at lunch, or when the front desk is busy.
built: 24/7 AI receptionists that answer every call, book appointments, handle after-hours emergencies, and run automated recall campaigns — GDPR-compliant, set up in under 5 days.
result: Live service for UK dental practices. Optivio Automation is also the Google Play publisher of my 4 apps: TChess, DareClock, CertForge and Brick Breaker: Power Rush.
description: 24/7 AI receptionists for UK dental practices — answers every call, books appointments, handles after-hours emergencies, runs recall campaigns. Also the Google Play publisher of TChess, DareClock, CertForge and Brick Breaker: Power Rush.
